# Traefik — servlet-mapping-push-url

servlet-mapping with PUSH relocated to /VAADIN/push. The push URL resolves against the context, which here is the root, so the catch-all already carries it and the config is identical to servlet-mapping.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/ui/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Traefik dynamic config (`vaadin.yml`), mounted into
`/etc/traefik/dynamic`:

```yaml
# servlet-mapping with VAADIN_PUSH_URL=/VAADIN/push.
#
# Identical to servlet-mapping/vaadin.yml. The push URL resolves against the
# context, which here is the root, so the relocated endpoint lands at
# /VAADIN/push and the catch-all router already carries it. The NGINX sibling
# needs a dedicated exact-match location for it, purely to attach the Upgrade
# headers; Traefik upgrades on every route, so there is nothing to add.
http:
  routers:
    hilla-push:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/ui/HILLA/`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      priority: 100
      middlewares:
        - strip-ui
        - compress
      service: vaadin

    hilla-connect:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/ui/connect/`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      priority: 100
      middlewares:
        - strip-ui
        - compress
      service: vaadin

    # Everything else reaches the backend untouched: /ui/* for the Vaadin
    # servlet (including /ui/VAADIN/push), and the root-level resources that
    # stay at the root whatever the mapping is — /VAADIN/*, /sw.js,
    # /styles.css, /manifest.webmanifest, /icons/*, /images/*, /test-redirect.
    root:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      priority: 1
      middlewares:
        - compress
      service: vaadin

  services:
    vaadin:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://vaadin:8080

  middlewares:
    strip-ui:
      stripPrefix:
        prefixes:
          - "/ui"

    compress:
      compress:
        excludedContentTypes:
          - text/event-stream
          - text/plain
```

The entryPoints and the file provider come from the shared
[traefik.yml](../../traefik.yml), mounted read-only.
